questions.prompt: A familiar action affected another person. Explain the stated effect and ask about missing context without assuming blame.
questions.context:
A cup belonging to a partner was broken. The affected partner reports the broken cup but does not say whether the action was deliberate or who performed it. Describe the effect and ask what happened before assigning blame.
Familiar meanings available: marks an action done to someone or something; sorry; thank you.
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: I separated the stated effect from an inferred intention.
My request for context avoids an unsupported accusation.
